attributes.action: Do not fund the BBC through a compulsory broadband levy
attributes.additional_details: The Government has said future BBC funding should minimise cost of living pressures and keep household costs as low as possible. It has also said it is not considering a new tax on households. A compulsory internet levy would go against those principles. Many people do not use BBC services and may need that money for food, energy and other essentials. Internet access is essential for work, banking, healthcare and public services, and should not be used to force people to fund the BBC.
attributes.background: We want the Government to rule out any compulsory BBC charge on broadband, mobile internet or other internet services. People should not be forced to fund the BBC simply because they need internet access, especially if they do not use BBC services.

rejection.details:
We're not sure exactly what you'd like the Government or Parliament to do. The Government has not announced plans to introduce a broadband levy.

You could start a new petition explaining clearly what you would like the Government or Parliament to do.
